name: Fishing Pond
description: A fisher on a wooden dock plays a calm fishing game by itself: casts, waits, nibbles, hooks, fights, reels and lifts a catch into the bucket. The lake follows the day: day, sunset, night.

steps.script: const sc = ["day","sunset","night"].map((id) => window.__fp[id]); const e = await addElement('IMG', { src: sc[0] }); e.name = 'Lake and dock'; e.src = sc[0]; e.images = sc; e.handle = 'scene'; e.x = 0; e.y = 0; e.show = 'normal'; return sc.length
const n = project.elements.length; ['Hour','Colon','Minute'].forEach((nm,i)=>{ project.elements[n-3+i].name = nm + ' Aod'; }); return 1

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gRig = 'Fishing'; project.groups.gBucket = 'Bucket'; let n = 0; for (const e of project.elements) { if (['Fisher','Rod and line','Hooked fish','Splash'].includes(e.name) || /^(Fish shadow|Sparkle)/.test(e.name)) { e.group = 'gRig'; n++ } if (/^Bucket fish/.test(e.name)) { e.group = 'gBucket'; n++ } } return n

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gDate = 'Date'; let n = 0; for (const e of project.elements) { if (e.name === 'Weekday' || e.name === 'Day' || e.name === 'Month') { e.group = 'gDate'; n++ } } for (const k of Object.keys(project.groups)) if (project.groups[k] === 'Clock 2') project.groups[k] = 'Clock AOD'; return n
